title: Villager shoots a silver-suited hovering assailant with a shotgun

tellings.quote: And he said, "I shot him at point blank range with a shotgun." And it and the blast the shotgun, he could hear the the the BB's dink off the armor and it knocked the guy back on his butt.

plain: In 2023, in the Alto Nanay region of the Peruvian Amazon, a villager says he was attacked by a hovering figure in a silver suit and shot it with a shotgun at point-blank range. He could hear the pellets ping off its armour, and the blast knocked the figure back onto the ground. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels what the villager told him, and if true it would mean armoured beings that can hover were attacking people in remote villages.
